text: For #900: /act hands an issue the factory hasn't taken to the factory with the one command that fits it. An issue whose text names one change, in a Kind:, Project: or Code: line, is handed over with /invariant solve, and one that names none is planned as a PRD with /invariant plan. The page had offered /invariant plan for every one, and all fourteen issues listed on 2026-11-13 were single changes, for which a plan spends a draft and a ratification to restate the issue as a step. A solve already proposes a plan of issues when a change can't fit one pull request. An issue whose text has a Waits: line, outside any fenced block, is listed with that reason, folded below those that are ready, and neither command is offered or posted for it until the line is taken out. The line is the dashboard's convention only, and the factory takes such an issue if a writer commands it on GitHub. The server refuses whichever command doesn't fit, since the page offers only what the server takes.
